newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- Conrail up on new bid.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- Conrail up on new bid.

text.p: Shares in Conrail Inc traded up 2-1/4 to 94-1/2 preceding Wednesday's market open after CSX Corp sweetened the terms of its friendly merger agreement with Conrail.

Under the new terms, 40 percent of Conrail shares would be acquired at $110 per share, up from $92.50 per share, while the remaining 60 percent would be acquired at the original stock-swap ratio of 1.85619 CSX shares for each Conrail shares.
The richer terms are intended to counter Norfolk Southern Corp's $100 per share unwelcome bid for Conrail.
After CSX unveiled the new offer this morning, Norfolk said it remains committed to the all cash bid, which was rejected by Conrail.
Shares in Norfolk and CSX were unmoved in pre-open trade, traders said.
Elsewhere, Loctite Corp shares rose to 58-3/4 from 57-7/8 after major shareholder Henkel KGaA launched a hostile bid for the 65 percent of the company it does not already own for $57.75 per share.
